cause.goalTitle: Prüfungsaufgabe: Brechung und Linsen mit dem Strahlenmodell untersuchen
cause.explanation: The first repair removed RP stage-local prerequisiteOnly supports when adding the same stable IDs as target under SekII astronomy. The existing Sek-I assessment remained target; it was not newly introduced or newly made applicable. generateCurriculumQualityStatus.ts filters expected applicabilityFromRequires assessments against stage-local available supports. The removed model support made the unchanged assessment appear unexpected. RP stage authority propagates this defect to the national GK/LK and Sek-I projections for DE-RP.

didacticAssessment.content: The released 18-point underwater-camera assessment combines qualitative refraction and optical apparent elevation, convex/concave lens ray constructions, and explanation of the function, assumptions and limits of the ray model. Its requires and coveredGoalIds are the same three relevant competencies: refraction, lens images and model function.
didacticAssessment.decision: Retain its exact pre-repair Sek-I support, including the observation prerequisite of model function. Keep the newly learnable Sek-II astronomy method targets. This preserves two independently authored stage uses of the same canonical competencies without promoting the Sek-I supports into new stage targets, changing assessment content, or changing route expectations.
didacticAssessment.sourceEvidenceBoundary: No new RP or 16-state curriculum source coverage is claimed; assessment-requires is applicability evidence only.
didacticAssessment.learnerBoundary: The retained Sek-I prerequisiteOnly supports remain global-mastery checks, not a newly authored empty-mastery Sek-I learning route. The Sek-II method sequence remains target and starts after the existing regular orientation. Narrow-focus and orientation boundaries from the first receipt remain in force.
